name: Heroicons
summary: 316 hand-crafted SVG icons by the makers of Tailwind CSS, in outline, solid, mini and micro styles.
description: A hand-crafted SVG icon set of 316 icons from the Tailwind CSS team, with four styles: outline (24x24, 1.5px stroke), solid, mini and micro. The set ships with React and Vue libraries and a Figma file, and is released under the MIT license.
contains: four styles: outline, solid, mini and micro
outline icons are 24x24 with a 1.5px stroke
